# event from-location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventFromLocation`](gmeow-eventFromLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventFromLocation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The origin of a movement event — where a migration, move, journey, or relocation departed from. A specialisation of [`gmeow:eventLocation`](gmeow-eventLocation.md) (the origin IS a location of the event), so plain location consumers still see it. Pairs with [`gmeow:eventToLocation`](gmeow-eventToLocation.md); the endpoint pair is the discrete sibling of the continuous [`gmeow:eventTrajectory`](gmeow-eventTrajectory.md) ([schema:MoveAction](https://schema.org/MoveAction)'s fromLocation).
